observations.behavior: Adds a runtime check to skip schema discovery and return immediately if the caught exception is an instance of `UndecryptedIntegrationSecretError`, regardless of the error message or the list of configured non-retryable errors.
observations.posthog_connection: This prevents the workflow from entering a retry loop for a known, permanent credential failure, avoiding unnecessary API calls and error tracking spam.
